input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 vests ownership of the whole Work in Garman, expressly including the "Modifications" set out in Schedule "D" — i.e. the bespoke work we commission and pay for — and states that no title passes to us. The only counterbalance is the narrow Section 2 licence to use the Software and Documentation at Authorized Locations, which does not on its face extend to Improvements or Modifications and carries no modify/sublicence rights (Section 3(c)-(d)). The Agreement is also silent on ownership of our data: Section 4(b) has Garman converting "Sparkling's data" and Section 14 treats it only as mutual Confidential Information, with no statement that we retain all rights in it. That falls short of both the preferred position (we own what is created for us; Vendor IP embedded in deliverables is licensed back perpetually) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to deliverables), so it is a material deviation on a critical rule. We have not disturbed Garman's ownership of its underlying software, which the playbook accepts; the minimal edit adds a carve-out confirming we retain all rights in our data and pre-existing IP and that our (already perpetual, per Section 17(a)) licence covers Improvements and Modifications.

proposal.summary: Add Sparkling data/IP ownership carve-out to Section 13 and confirm the Section 2 licence extends to Improvements and Modifications
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 gives Garman ownership of the Work including the Modifications we fund, and the Agreement says nothing about our own data, so we have added a short carve-out confirming we retain all rights in our data and pre-existing IP and that our licence extends to Improvements and Modifications. Our playbook requires that we keep ownership of Customer Data and receive a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything created for us; we are content for Garman to retain ownership of its underlying software.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in and to its data (including data converted pursuant to Section 4) and its pre-existing intellectual property, and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Garman any ownership of, or licence to use (other than as necessary to perform Garman's obligations hereunder), Sparkling's data or intellectual property. The licence granted in Section 2 extends to all Improvements and Modifications and, subject to Section 17(a), is perpetual, irrevocable and royalty-free.
